means.example-sentence: Generally speaking, Japanese women live longer than Japanese men by about six years.
means.sentence-jp: 一般的に言えば、日本人女性は日本人男性より6年ほど長生きだ。

cloze.maskedText: ____, Japanese women live longer than Japanese men by about six years.

notes: 慣用的な分詞構文。似た例に strictly speaking「厳密に言えば」、frankly speaking「率直に言えば」、roughly speaking「大ざっぱに言えば」などがある。
